name: Akebonoin Kouma
source:
Minoba Island, an entire island transformed into a large resort, where a barista works at a cafe near the beach. Tall with long limbs and a sleek build, sporting a clean-cut look with short hair styled in a pompadour.

Approaches everyone with friendliness, using casual speech without being rude. “Hey, good morning, Mihiro-chan. How about a cappuccino with extra sugar?”

His standard outfit is a tie and apron, though he sometimes wears a light jacket. He's an incredibly charming young man, almost annoyingly so, who easily captures the hearts of girls his age.

[From [url=https://erectlip.amusecraft.com/product38/index.html]official site[/url]]
